parameters.scope: All 205 libraries descriptive; additional single-physical-flowcell descriptive subsets only; no new tests or models.
parameters.eukaryote_selection: count_as_detection=true in reviewed evidence; no ancestor/descendant double-counting.
parameters.units: Bacterial/archaeal/viral counts are accepted genome targets; eukaryote counts are reviewed reporting groups. They are not equivalent richness measures.
parameters.zero_interpretation: No accepted detection in the reviewed evidence, not established biological absence.
parameters.depth_strata: Physalia at assigned/recorded surface; other hosts entirely within 0-20 m, entirely below 20 m, crossing 20 m, or unknown. Intervals have no imputed midpoint.
parameters.physalia_depths: 150 curator-assigned surface values and one source-record zero are distinguished.
parameters.roles: Roles are evidence annotations. A library may contain both potential prey and potential parasites.
parameters.tissue_groups: Source tissue descriptions are lowercased; empty values are unknown. No anatomical localization is inferred from DNA presence.
parameters.host_tissue_check: A fixed secondary descriptive subset of Physalia utriculus compares regional incidence within one host species and tissue description; all-library and single-flowcell scopes remain separate.
parameters.lifestyle: Physalia neustonic; Stephalia dilata benthic; remaining taxa broadly pelagic, not depth-derived.
parameters.interpretation: Post hoc exploratory descriptions; host, depth, region, tissue, sampling time and sequencing batch overlap.
